text:
Priya: Noticing a small but persistent stripe of GPU attach failures in us-east1 starting ~02:01 UTC. infra-bot fired a cluster alert for increased attach latency.
infra-bot: [02:01] attach_latency_spike=120ms cluster=gpu-prod-use1 sample_hosts=host-401..host-412
Tom: Any storage errors on those hosts?
Evan: Checking. SMART shows elevated recovered sector counts and a couple of medium count media errors on the local NVMe lot. Firmware 3.4.1-rc2 again.
Evan: smartctl snippet: "Model: ACME NVMe X123; Serial: ACME-USE1-007; Firmware: 3.4.1-rc2; Media Errors: 6"
Nora: We're mid-run on a clusterdefrag compaction tonight in that region which increases write pressure. Could be correlated.
Priya: Risk: if we drain all 12 hosts at once we lose ~15% GPU capacity. Can we instead quarantine one at a time and throttle compaction?
Tom: Plan: (1) Tag the cohort nvme-candidate-3_4_1rc2 (2) Pause heavy compaction jobs in use1 for 40m (3) Live-migrate critical GPU pods off any host that shows EIOs or read-after-write mismatches.
Evan: Quick verify: running a targeted read-after-write check on replicated test extents only. Script: "write pattern -> fdatasync -> read and cmp". Will run only on hosts already cordoned.
infra-bot: Started cordon of host-405..host-408 per runbook.
Nora: Also reduce janitor throughput globally by 50% to lower background write bandwidth. Ops oncall approved.
Priya: I've alerted support and asked vendor for fw regression check. Opening ticket with smart logs and kernel traces.
Tom: Migration commands I'm using: "rbctl host tag add host-405 nvme-candidate-3_4_1rc2; rbctl host set-attr host-405 scrub.pause=true; rbctl host drain host-405 --reason 'nvme partial write risk'"
Evan: After running the verify on host-405 we saw 1 mismatched block out of 1000 sampled. Quarantine that host and collect dd images for forensic.
infra-bot: migration progress: 4/12 VMs moved, 8 remaining (ETA ~22m)
Priya: Update +28m: attach latency back to baseline after throttles and single-host quarantine. Still awaiting vendor confirmation. We're deferring full rollback unless mismatch samples increase.
Nora: Cost impact: moving workloads to adjacent spare pools increases cross-region egress marginally; finance notified.
Tom: Next steps: vendor RMA if more mismatches; otherwise resume compaction in slow ramp with 10% cap and continuous read-after-write sampling for 3 hours. I'll follow up with a short incident note.
